Software and Subscriptions.description: Software licences, SaaS tools and subscriptions used for the business.
Software and Subscriptions.not_included: Personal apps or subscriptions unrelated to the business.

Domain / Hosting / Website.description: Domain registration, hosting, and website build/maintenance costs.
Domain / Hosting / Website.not_included: Personal websites or domains unrelated to the business.

Professional Fees.description: Accountancy, legal, consultancy and other professional service fees.
Professional Fees.not_included: Personal legal or professional advice unrelated to the business.

Marketing and Advertising.description: Advertising, promotion, sponsored content and marketing spend.

Bank and Transaction Fees.description: Business bank account, card processing and transaction fees.
Bank and Transaction Fees.message: Fully deductible; most bank fees carry no reclaimable VAT.

Insurance.description: Professional indemnity, public liability and business insurance premiums.
Insurance.message: Fully deductible; insurance premiums are VAT exempt.

Office Supplies and Stationery.description: Stationery, consumables and small office supplies.

Training and Professional Development.description: Courses, certifications and professional development directly relevant to the business.
Training and Professional Development.not_included: General education unrelated to the business.
Training and Professional Development.message: Fully deductible where directly relevant to the business.

Subcontractor Fees.description: Payments to subcontractors for work carried out for the business.
Subcontractor Fees.not_included: Payments to employees (see Salaries and Wages).
Subcontractor Fees.message: Fully deductible; confirm RCT/PSWT obligations if applicable.

Salaries and Wages.description: Gross pay and employer costs for employees.
Salaries and Wages.not_included: Owner drawings (sole trader) or director remuneration treated separately.
Salaries and Wages.message: Fully deductible; payroll taxes apply separately.

Equipment and Hardware.description: Computers, equipment and hardware used for the business.
Equipment and Hardware.not_included: Consumables or low-value supplies (see Office Supplies).
Equipment and Hardware.message: May be a capital item — large purchases can require capital allowances treatment rather than a single-year deduction.
Equipment and Hardware.action: Keep the receipt and check with your accountant before claiming the full amount this year if the purchase is over €1,000.
Equipment and Hardware.amount_threshold_message: Amounts over €1,000 may require capital allowances treatment — confirm with your accountant before saving.

Home Office Expenses.description: Business-use portion of home costs — heat, light, broadband.
Home Office Expenses.not_included: Rent, mortgage capital repayments, or the personal-use portion of any home cost.
Home Office Expenses.message: Only the business-use portion is deductible — apportion carefully and keep a record of the basis used.
Home Office Expenses.action: Enter only the business-use share of the cost here, and keep a note of how you worked out the split.

Motor Expenses.description: Business-use portion of motor running costs — fuel, servicing, insurance.
Motor Expenses.not_included: Private mileage or personal motoring costs.
Motor Expenses.message: Only the business-use portion is deductible — keep a mileage log to support the split.
Motor Expenses.action: Enter only the business-use share of the cost here, and keep a mileage log to support it.

Phone and Communications.description: Business-use portion of phone and communications costs.
Phone and Communications.not_included: Personal calls/data unrelated to the business.
Phone and Communications.message: Only the business-use portion is deductible if the plan is also used personally.
Phone and Communications.action: Enter only the business-use share of the cost here if the plan is also used personally.

Travel and Subsistence.description: Business travel, accommodation and subsistence while away from the normal place of work.
Travel and Subsistence.not_included: Commuting to your normal place of work, or personal travel.
Travel and Subsistence.message: Only genuine business travel qualifies — commuting costs are not deductible.
Travel and Subsistence.action: Only include genuine business travel here — leave out your normal commute.

Entertainment.not_included: Nothing — client entertainment is never deductible and VAT is never reclaimable on it.
Entertainment.message: Entertainment is Non-Deductible — this expense will be recorded but excluded from your tax calculation.
Entertainment.action: You should still record it. Revenue expects to see entertainment expenses in your books even though they cannot be claimed as a deduction.
Entertainment.modal_message: This expense will be saved as Non-Deductible and excluded from your tax deduction calculation. It will still appear in your cash flow records as Revenue expects to see entertainment expenses in your books.

Personal Expenses.not_included: Any expense with a business purpose — reclassify it to the correct category instead.
Personal Expenses.message: Personal Expenses is Non-Deductible — this expense will be recorded but excluded from your tax calculation.
Personal Expenses.action: If this cost has a genuine business purpose, reclassify it to the correct category instead. Otherwise it should not be run through the business.

Fines and Penalties.description: Nothing — fines and penalties are never deductible.
Fines and Penalties.not_included: Any genuine business cost — this category exists only to record fines/penalties for audit purposes.
Fines and Penalties.message: Fines and Penalties is Non-Deductible — this expense will be recorded but excluded from your tax calculation.
Fines and Penalties.action: You should still record it for audit purposes. It can never be claimed as a deduction and VAT cannot be reclaimed on it.

BTWEA / Welfare Support.description: Back to Work Enterprise Allowance and similar welfare supports.
BTWEA / Welfare Support.message: BTWEA/welfare payments are non-trading income — keep them separate from taxable trading income and do not include them in turnover calculations.

Grant Income.description: Grants received from state bodies, local enterprise offices or other schemes.
Grant Income.message: Grants may be taxable or exempt depending on the scheme — confirm the correct tax treatment with your accountant or Revenue guidance before relying on this figure.

field_rules.receipt_required_message: Revenue requires documentary evidence for expenses over €50. Ensure you have the receipt.
field_rules.cash_amount_message: Large cash transactions require supporting documentation.
field_rules.entertainment_vat_message: VAT cannot be reclaimed on entertainment expenses.
